title: Even-level coefficients of odd-arity majority
statement: Let $n$ be an odd nonnegative integer and let $S$ be a finite set of coordinates in $\\{0,\\ldots,n-1\\}$ with even cardinality. The Fourier coefficient of the majority function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube at $S$ is zero.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is a finite set of coordinates in $\\{0,\\ldots,n-1\\}$
